scenes.brief: Required variant and data: see docs/SCENES.md row "memory-fab-map" and its data shape under 頁面資料 → custom（memory-fab-map）: { asOf, fabs:[{ id, company, companyName, href, name, city, country, lat, lon, products, status, capacityKwpm?, capacityStatus?, addKwpm?, capex?, timeline?, note? }] }. The host page is /memory/ (being built in parallel by another workflow from src/data/memory/fabs.yaml; do not edit pages or src/data). Ship src/three/fixtures/memory-fab-map.json with about 30 real memory sites (SK hynix 利川 M14/M16, 清州 M15/M15X, 龍仁, 無錫, 大連, 印第安納 West Lafayette; Samsung 華城, 平澤 P1–P5, 器興, 西安, 天安/溫陽 packaging; Micron Boise ID1/ID2, 紐約 Clay, 廣島, 台中, 桃園, 新加坡; Kioxia/SanDisk 四日市, 北上; CXMT 合肥; YMTC 武漢; 南亞科 新北/泰山; 華邦電 台中/高雄) with city-level coordinates and ILLUSTRATIVE capacities, and show the 「示意資料」 badge when the fixture is used. Design: use kit Globe like cloud-globe/company-globe (read both first and reuse their patterns). Each fab is a column rising from the globe: height ∝ sqrt(capacityKwpm) (a short stub when unknown), colour by product family (DRAM, HBM 與 HBM 封裝, NAND, HDD/SSD/其他) using theme tokens readable in both themes, status encoded by form as well as colour (operating = solid; expanding = solid + a translucent extension segment of height ∝ addKwpm; construction/planned = hollow or wireframe ghost column; delayed = ghost + warning ring) so it is never colour-only; a legend in HTML. Dense clusters (Korea: 利川／華城／平澤／器興／龍仁／清州 within ~100 km; Taiwan; Japan) must stay readable: spread markers in a small local fan or offset, and provide a zoom-to-region step. HTML controls in the scene controls slot (as in SCENE-CONTRACT): product filter (全部／DRAM／HBM／NAND／HDD 與其他) and status filter (全部／現有產能／擴產與新建); filters animate columns in/out. Hover/focus card: company (zh) + site, products, status, capacity in 千片/月 with 「估計」 when capacityStatus is estimate, expansion (+addKwpm), capex, timeline; click opens href (company page). Steps 由淺入深: 1 全球總覽 (memory production is concentrated in Korea, Taiwan, Japan, China, US, Singapore), 2 韓國 DRAM／HBM 重鎮 (zoom to Korea), 3 HBM 封裝與新產能 (US Indiana, Idaho/New York, Japan Hiroshima, Taiwan, Singapore — highlight expanding/construction), 4 NAND 版圖 (Japan, China, Korea), 5 中國自主產能 (CXMT, YMTC). Slow auto-rotation that stops on interaction; reduced motion = static. Never hard-code statistics in labels; all numbers come from data. When the scene passes its test, capture its posters with npx tsx scripts/capture-posters.ts --ids memory-fab-map (dev server must be running) and verify with --verify.
